learning_objective: 🎯 To understand that true friendship doesn't care about our differences, and that teamwork makes us stronger!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The story introduces animals who look completely different and have different skills, but they share a beautiful and strong bond of friendship.
One day, a friend gets into terrible trouble and is trapped! The situation looks hopeless, and nobody can escape on their own.
The other friends do not run away. Instead, they combine their unique skills. The fast one runs, the sharp one bites, and the smart one plans!
By working together as a team, they easily defeat the danger. They prove that when friends unite, no problem is too big to solve.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Build Your Dream Team!
fun_activity.instructions: If you had an animal rescue team, which three animals would you choose? Draw them and write what special power each one brings to the team!

quick_recap: ⭐ Very different animals became the best of friends.
⭐ When one friend fell into danger, the others rushed to help.
⭐ They used their different abilities to work as a perfect team.
⭐ They successfully rescued their friend, proving the power of unity.
